provenance.method: Explicitly closed continuous red line ring from each official PDF vector layer; embedded WKT, viewport and control coordinates determine projected affine transform; inverse projection only, no snapping/buffer/clipping/simplification. Each full page visually reviewed, including target labels, neighboring labels and boundary legend. Active PDF clips and pinned country geometry checked.

limitations: Official2023 map geometry is not certified for changes after publication.
Five-decimal-degree geospatial controls impose finite georeferencing precision; residual is fit consistency, not external survey accuracy.
Cross-map boundaries may show small gaps or overlaps from independently rounded controls. Do not invent snapped borders to conceal them.
Several source polygons differ materially; the evidence supports replacing footprints along with names, not merely relabeling excess land.
